messages.subject: GCC Executive Profile | Energy, Government Relations, ESG & External Affairs
messages.body:
Dear B7 Executive Search Team,

Your Middle East executive-search coverage across energy, utilities, government, construction and engineering aligns closely with my leadership background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where major projects require regulatory coordination, institutional trust and responsible execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
